correctness.rationale: Direct reduction to one quadratic mode followed by exact Jury inequalities gives all three regions; derivative and asymptotic calculations give the sharp minima and stiff-friction limits, and direct eigenvalue checks agree on all tested points.

originality.rationale: Generic harmonic Langevin stability analysis is known and excluded. No checked source states the exact LC-UBU/LCT-UBU/LCP-UBU phase diagram, Taylor z=2 barrier, Pade minimum, or the three-way stiff-friction scaling for the newly introduced schemes.

value.rationale: The result separates schemes that share the same formal convergence order but have opposite stiff-friction stability scaling, giving a sharp implementation-relevant diagnostic for the new low-cost UBU family.
